summary: Frontend-only regression test (iteration_6) verifying the visual overhaul applied to Strategy / Upload (Add Trade) / Pre-Trade Grader screens. All 6 requested flows PASS on mobile viewport 390x844 as owner@trademind.ai. No red screens, no pageerrors, no functional regressions. Verified: (1) Login submits, What's New (whats-new-dismiss) + Daily Quote (daily-quote-dismiss) modals dismiss cleanly. (2) Strategy tab (/strategy) renders with ScreenBackground + orange gradient 'New Strategy' FAB glow; found 20 preset chips + 3 seeded strategies. Preset tap opens editor prefilled ('Opening Range Breakout'); new-strategy -> filled strategy-name/strategy-risk/rule-0/add-rule/rule-1 -> save-strategy persisted (list grew 3->4, name visible after reload). Edit (strategy-<id>) loads prefilled form. Delete (del-strategy-<id>) removes from list (verified 'still visible: False'). (3) Upload (fab-upload) opens; pick-camera + pick-gallery boxes with brand glow present; analyze-btn correctly disabled (aria-disabled=true) with no image — click didn't navigate away; taken-yes/taken-no toggle both directions; 3 strat-<id> chips toggle to accent (orange). (4) Pre-Trade Grader — reachable via pretrade-btn from dashboard (not locked for premium); pt-camera/pt-gallery pickers with brand-glowed dashed boxes; 3 pt-strat-<id> chips toggle. Note: hard URL navigation to /pretrade redirects to / (auth-restore quirk in Expo Router, pre-existing, not a restyle bug) — internal link via pretrade-btn works. (5) Dashboard — account-balance $51,549.76 renders, all 4 tabs+profile navigate. Same two console deprecation warnings persist from iter5 (shadow* + pointerEvents) — pre-existing, NOT introduced by this restyle.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still repeats on every page load: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' The new visual overhaul heavily uses glow() (FAB, gradient CTAs, pickers, taken toggles, strategy cards). Non-blocking — styles render — but pollutes console on RN Web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (glow() using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Same as iter4/iter5 — not caused by the restyle. Non-blocking.

Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Triggered by the new PressableScale / FadeInDown entrance animations added in the restyle. Non-blocking on Expo Web, but recommend guarding with Platform.OS !== 'web' for the FadeInDown wrapper if the warning noise is undesired.

test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_review.py (regression backend suite — not re-run this iteration; request was frontend-only)
action_items: OPTIONAL — Silence 'shadow* deprecated' warning: migrate glow()/cardShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to Platform.select({ web: { boxShadow: '...' }, default: { shadowColor, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius, shadowOffset } }). This restyle amplified the warning frequency because glow() is now applied to many more surfaces.
OPTIONAL — Suppress useNativeDriver warning on web by conditionally wrapping FadeInDown entrance animations with Platform.OS !== 'web'.
NO functional fixes required — visual overhaul of Strategy / Upload / Pre-Trade Grader is safe to ship.
